# SketchUp

> SketchUp is a professional 3D design and modeling software platform serving architects, designers, landscape professionals, and construction teams with intuitive tools for visualization and collaboration.

SketchUp, owned by Trimble, provides comprehensive 3D modeling solutions across multiple industries including architecture, construction, interior design, and landscape architecture. The platform integrates with complementary tools like LayOut, PreDesign, Trimble Connect, and Scan Essentials to support complete design workflows from concept to collaboration.

## Key Topics

- 3D Modeling

- [SketchUp Pro - Professional 3D Modeling Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/plans-and-pricing/sketchup-pro): SketchUp Pro professional 3D modeling software with LayOut and PreDesign tools.

## Industry Solutions

- [Architecture - Architectural Design Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/industries/architecture): SketchUp architectural design software with construction document tools.
- [Construction - 3D Construction Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/industries/construction): SketchUp construction modeling software for floor plans and BIM workflows.
- [Landscape Architecture - 3D Landscape Design Tool](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/industries/landscape-architecture): SketchUp landscape architecture industry solution with terrain modeling tools.
- [Interior Design - Professional Interior Design Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/industries/interior-design): SketchUp interior design tool with photoreal rendering and visualization.
- [Urban Planning - 3D Urban Planning & Design Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/industries/urban-planning): SketchUp urban planning and 3D city design software for visualization.

## Complementary Products

- [Trimble Connect - Construction Collaboration Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/products/trimble-connect): Trimble Connect collaboration platform for construction project management and cloud storage.
- [Scan Essentials - Point Cloud to 3D Model Software](https://sketchup.trimble.com/en/products/scan-essentials): Scan Essentials product for converting point clouds to 3D models.
